acceptanceCriteria: At least 100 valid warm samples are required for every release-grade percentile; a 99-sample input is rejected and unavailable metrics are explicit.
Baseline and candidate use the same machine, toolchain, build mode, and selected object-repository facts; raw samples, p50/p95/p99, identities, counters, and invalidation reasons are retained.

The measured object set includes goods-garden, sentinel, and ai-investigation-orchestrator through temporary isolated views; their main branches and existing dirty state are not modified, and every temporary resource is cleaned exactly.
Runtime latency and development-cycle cost are separately reported; unavailable lifecycle stages remain unavailable rather than zero.
The three-language Work Item projection and reference-parity rows remain synchronized before archive.
Focused performance tests and documentation gates pass; this Work Item does not publish a release.
The benchmark manifest is imported as existing delegated external evidence; its self-reported assurance is not elevated to provider verification.
goal: Measure current v0.2.95 Runtime behavior against the public v0.2.93 baseline on representative object repositories, report valid warm samples and explicit unknowns, and keep release publication as a later step.
intent: Use three clean temporary worktree views of selected object repositories to produce current paired Runtime performance evidence without modifying their main branches.

sources: Local runtime benchmark capture manifest bound through the existing delegated evidence import.
